content.intro: Treat externally supplied scripts, configuration, paths, and serialized data as untrusted inputs. A restricted global table alone is not a secure sandbox; isolate untrusted work and enforce limits outside the Lua process.

content_blocks.title: Work through the example
content_blocks.text: Read the small example, predict every output line, then run it locally with a compatible runtime. A restricted environment reduces available globals but is not, by itself, a secure sandbox. Use process isolation and host-enforced limits for untrusted code. Keep the smallest reproducible case if the observed behavior differs.

items.title: Mistake 1
items.text: Confusing Designing Restricted Environments with a similarly named feature in another language or runtime. Fix: follow the version-matched reference and test the smallest example.

items.title: Mistake 2
items.text: Relying on an output order or environment capability that the language/host does not guarantee. Fix: document assumptions and make order/capabilities explicit.

items.title: Mistake 3
items.text: Skipping a boundary test or failing to check error-return values. Fix: test invalid and boundary inputs and inspect failure values.
